Name: Gus Always Visits Ginger Island
Author: ragequit1995
Description:
[b]Gus Always Visits Ginger Island[/b]
Ever notice Gus almost never goes to the Ginger Island resort? With big NPC mods like Stardew Valley Expanded or Ridgeside Village, there are dozens of eligible visitors, so he rarely gets picked. This mod makes sure he goes.
[b]What it does[/b]
On any day the resort has visitors, Gus is guaranteed to be one of them. If the game didn’t pick him, he swaps in for one random visitor. He gets his normal resort bar spot and heads back to the Saloon in the evening, just like in vanilla.
[b]What it doesn’t do[/b]
[list]
[*]No visitors on rainy days, festivals, or when the resort is closed or not restored. The mod doesn’t change that.[/*]
[*]Gus won’t be forced if he can’t visit (for example, another mod blocks him).[/*]
[*]It never replaces a player’s spouse.[/*]
[/list][b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village and other NPC mods. It makes no content edits.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer safe. Only the host runs it.[/*]
[*]No config, and it’s safe to add to or remove from an existing save.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip the download into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Source code[/b]
Open source on GitHub: https://github.com/Fr0styJ/gus-always-visits-ginger-island
